summary: Silver Bow Mining Corp. entered an asset purchase agreement on August 21, 2026, whereby its wholly-owned subsidiary, Silver Bow Tunnels Corp., will acquire certain assets of Montana Tunnels Mining, Inc. (MTMI) comprising the Montana Tunnels Mine and Diamond Hill Mill, including mineral, real property, water rights, and permits. The acquisition occurs through MTMI's Chapter 11 bankruptcy sale under Section 363, requiring Bankruptcy Court approval. Silver Bow will escrow approximately $28.6 million to satisfy specified creditors, including Jefferson County and Montana DEQ obligations, with release contingent on a final order by September 30, 2026. The deal structure features staged closings. Watch for court approval and creditor release timing.
